def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] -> values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    Returns the value of mode, then the value of level, then the values of any
    other keys in the order they first appear in keys. If a key repeats, its
    last value wins.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
    ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
    ex settings(["a", "b", "a"], ["1", "2", "3"]) == ["fast", "3", "3", "2"]
    mode = "fast".copy()
    level = "3".copy()
    other: dict[str, str] = {}
    order: list[str] = []
    for k, v in zip(keys, values):
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v.copy()
        elif k == "level":
            level = v.copy()
        else:
            if k not in other:
                order.append(k.copy())
            other[k.copy()] = v.copy()
    out: list[str] = [mode, level]
    for k in order:
        out.append((other.get(k) else "").copy())
    return out
